newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.034pts to 103.391.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.034pts to 103.391.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.034 points in Wednesday's trading to 103.391 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.076 points to 2.771 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.004 points to 100.914, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.385 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.710 points to 1,024.383.
